purpose: Explain the staged construction of AI Shipping Labs

required_facts.fact: The first platform was a Next.js site built by Valeriia with v0 and Cursor.
The MVP tested signups and subscriptions.
Subscription tiers progressed from tutorials to community and courses.
Content was repurposed from newsletters, events and projects.
Stripe and AWS hosting were added later.
The Django platform used PM, SWE, Tester and On-Call agents.
The first task decomposition lacked acceptance criteria and was revised.
Manual API-key and integration testing remained necessary.

author_attribution: Distinguish Valeriia's Next.js work from Alexey's later Django and agent-team work.
